notes.title: 🎄 Merry Christmas from EntropyDE! 🎁
notes.content:
[h1]🎄 Merry Christmas from EntropyDE! 🎄[/h1]  

Hey everyone! 🎅✨  

The holiday season is here, and we just want to take a moment to wish you all a very Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! 🎁❄️  

Thank you for being an incredible part of our community this year. 

Your support, feedback, and enthusiasm mean the world to us. Whether you’re diving into our games or exploring our latest releases, you’ve helped make this an unforgettable year for EntropyDE.  

[hr][/hr]  
We hope your holidays are filled with love, laughter, and maybe even some cheeky fun in the worlds we’ve created for you. Here’s to a fantastic 2025 ahead, with more exciting adventures, stories, and surprises on the horizon! 🥂  

Stay warm, stay safe, and have an amazing holiday season! ❤️  

With love,  
The EntropyDE Team 🎄✨

notes.title: Touchdown Girls Content Patch Update v0.01-014
notes.content:
Touchdown Girls Content Patch Update v0.01-014 includes several bug fixes for issues that were reported by users in our game forums. 

- Included formatting of Centerfold Gallery Images
- Choice selection in the Art Studio to allow Shona to keep her robe on during the modeling scene before advancing to the next scene

We'll continue to check the forums for new bugs that are being reported and continue to issue patches to the game

notes.title: Spanish Language / Latin America Translation Update
notes.content: Responding to feedback from our user forums, we've improved and updated the Spanish Language / Latin America Translation version of Touchdown Girls. With this small update we've spent additional time to ensure that Spanish language users have the best user experience possible while playing the game.
